neu: Map areas from the Core are saved on the SD card and keep loading from the internet without the Core; progress per area on the Navi page and in the footer; no more Wi-Fi drops every 90 s in the home Wi-Fi
Map loading no longer restarts every 10 min for the update check or on short Wi-Fi drops; the map counter no longer jumps back
Map loading no longer restarts when the Core resends the same area list; Navi page shows why loading restarted ('Map restarts')
Fix: map type no longer switches to street map by itself – touch is off by default (phantom taps), settings always follow the Core
Header shows the battery as 'Bat: 3,93V 76%'
New layout: speed large on the map (bottom left), GPS status on the map (top right), Navi IP and version in the footer (bottom right)
Navi version shown on the display (bottom right, before the GPS status)
Update card on the Navi page (navi.local): installed/online version, check and install buttons; update errors stay visible for 2 min
Fix: 'Core not found' / red GPS / maps stopping – the Core counted as lost when a packet arrived during drawing (timer overflow)
Map stays still when standing (ignores GPS jitter under 8 m below 3 km/h); fixed separator between battery % and voltage
Cell voltage from the Core next to the battery %
Radio quality measured against the Core's real send rate; Core counts as lost only after 5 s; Wi-Fi power save always off
GPS status moved to the bottom right; battery % from the Core in the header
Auto zoom by scale bar: 20 m standing, 50 m at 50 km/h, 100 m from 80 km/h (adjustable on the Navi page)
Auto zoom by speed, smooth (also when playing a ride): close when standing, wider when fast – can be switched off on the Navi page
Fix: rides from the Core play on the Navi (were 'ride not found')
Fix: 'Check for update' works right away, also while maps are loading
Navi shows its IP address in the Navi status on the Core page (for VPN), name in the router: mojave-navi
Fix: the Core stays reachable while the Navi copies maps or rides (only one request to the Core at a time, no kept-open connections)
Fix: Navi switches to the Core's radio channel right away (stayed on a neighbour channel before); status text on the Core page is up to date
Play a ride on the Navi from its web page (navi.local): built-in demo, rides and virtual rides from the Core, speed 1-8x, repeat
Own settings page http://navi.local (works without the Core): status with progress bar, edit all config.txt settings
Maps load with two downloads at the same time (also when copying from the Core)
Landscape display (320x240) – default on the 2" board, config.txt quer: 0 for portrait
SD card: exFAT now works too (64 GB cards as they come), start screen shows size and format
Two own Wi-Fi networks in config.txt (wlan, wlan2) – tried in turn when the Core is off
Without GPS fix: last Core position, otherwise VGPS home position – map shows and maps load right away
Copies all map tiles from the Core (aerial + street map, zoom 13-18) on first contact, then every 30 min
Own Wi-Fi for maps without the Core (config.txt wlan/wlanPass); config.txt is created at first start
Fix: "No SD card" on the 2" board – the display no longer blocks the shared SPI bus; SD card can also be inserted later
First version for the Waveshare 2" touch board (240x320): touch to zoom (left/right), switch aerial/street map (middle), long press for heading/north up
Built-in SD card, more memory for map tiles, own update channel (navi/lcd2)
Optional own GPS on IO18/IO17
